crash.title: Crash reports
crash.description: This app captures its own panics and unhandled frontend exceptions as local-only reports (version, stack, log tail). Nothing is uploaded. Native crash dumps from the game or system are still opened via “Toolbox → Crash dump viewer”.

crash.noConfigDir: No config directory configured; no crash report folder to open

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.desc: Changes text size only, not the layout; multiplied with the UI scale above — handy for keeping text sharp on 2K / 4K screens

option.xlargeDesc: Most comfortable, fewer items on screen

readingComfort.label: Reading comfort
readingComfort.desc: Adjusts line spacing and text contrast: currently “{current}” — Soft = looser lines and softer contrast (easy on the eyes over long sessions); High contrast = darker text, better in bright light or with low vision

option.softDesc: Looser line spacing and softer contrast — easier on the eyes
option.contrastDesc: Darker text with tighter spacing; clearer in bright light or with low vision
